collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-31  -  THE WEARY ANIMAL SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A farmer notices that an animal helping carry supplies has become tired during the afternoon's work.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A farmer notices that an animal helping carry supplies has become tired during the afternoon's work.

choices.label: Stop and Allow the Animal to Rest.
Ask Other Workers to Share the Remaining Supplies.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The animal recovers its energy before returning at an easier pace.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The animal remains tired, so the farmer ends its work for the day.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The animal moves more comfortably with a lighter burden.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The animal still seems reluctant, and the farmer decides that rest is necessary.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The farmer discovers a poorly positioned strap and adjusts it.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Nothing obvious explains the fatigue, so the farmer seeks experienced help.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The villagers carry the final bundles themselves while the animal rests.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The work takes longer, but the animal is not pressed to continue.
